title: Add spec fields to WorkItemView and executor surfaces
description: WHY: WorkItemView omits description, acceptanceCriteria, sourceRefs, parentId and closedReason (packages/ui-model/src/work-view.ts lines 3-20 and 107-138), so work show, work claim, agent start and the handoff bundle never deliver the spec to the executing agent; the spec arrives only as the flattened one-line contextSummary built in packages/search/src/context-pack.ts lines 87-90. WHAT: add those fields to WorkItemView (or a spec sub-object), populate them in toWorkItemView, and confirm every caller (runtime.getWorkView at packages/engine/src/runtime.ts lines 960-962 and makeWorkView at 1718-1729, buildHandoffBundle at apps/cli/src/commands.ts lines 11015-11037, fallbackWorkView at 11062-11072) carries them through. Keep the change additive so existing JSON consumers do not break. Update apps/console and apps/mcp typings if they import the view type. TRUTH SOURCE: the WorkItem record shape at packages/core/src/records.ts lines 118-135.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk work show <id> --json returns description, acceptanceCriteria, sourceRefs, parentId and closedReason for a fixture work item
bwrk agent start claim handoff JSON includes the same spec fields
Existing view consumers compile and unit tests pass via pnpm test
closedReason: Implemented and verified in checkpoint ffa6c80a.
